scope: Re-verify existing K15 memory scoring, decay, decay tick, memory prefix and isInitial gate against the latest v2 mainline source. No production source or test changes; this is a regression checkpoint, not a new feature batch.
coverage: memory_scoring: heuristic factors/emotion/owner-private/group/manual importance/channel capture scoring and audit redaction
